scope: Inline Markdown/HTML images and external frontmatter cover/image fields under content/articles and content/generated/articles
availabilityMethod: One HEAD request with redirects; only HTTP 405/501 receive one ranged GET fallback. No retries, authentication bypass, image localization or license inference.
metricsBoundary: Observed counts come only from topPaths in the existing short-window report. Null means absent from those lists, not zero traffic or zero value.
